purpose: Record the first post-auth Prime pod attempt for the bounded Qwen 3B smoke, including the wallet debit and the reason no training ran.

attempted_steps.evidence: prime --plain whoami succeeded for team Zenobia Pay.
prime --plain wallet --output json reported $50.00 before launch and $49.9808 after termination.
RTX6000Ada_48GB resources were available; Massed Compute resource 03c728 was selected at $0.75/hour after Datacrunch and PyTorch-image attempts failed before creation.
prime --plain pods create --id 03c728 --name qwen3b-grounded-qa-smoke --disk-size 160 --gpu-count 1 --image ubuntu_22_cuda_12 --yes returned pod 6339a57c681b4f1e912754429b4d7784.
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa -o IdentitiesOnly=yes ubuntu@216.81.248.93 failed with publickey/password denial.

decision.next_step: Fix Prime SSH key provisioning in the Prime dashboard profile, or choose a backend/image path that exposes working SSH, then rerun the guarded launch from the read-only gates. Do not run paid judging until predictions and remote provenance exist.
decision.runbook_change_required: Require SSH preflight immediately after pod status and before repo sync or training.

external_reference.summary: Prime documentation says SSH keys are generated/managed from the dashboard profile and the CLI should be configured with the matching private key path.

llm_budget.note: This attempt launched and terminated a Prime pod, but no model training or OpenAI judge call ran.
